about_the_game:
As the only survivor of a fallen noble family, you are determined to uncover the mystery behind their demise. By an incredible stroke of luck, you secure an interview for the role of Imperial Governess. It is your singular opportunity to infiltrate the imperial palace, the very heart of the Empire's knowledge and power.

Soon, you realize shadows lurk beneath the palace's glittering façade. Survive deadly schemes, uncover buried secrets, and make choices that branch into multiple, dramatically different endings.

Will you earn allies or make powerful enemies? Will you unveil the truth that destroyed your family? Will romance between you and the imperial princes? And if it does, will it bring salvation or betrayal?

Your story awaits in Fate's Masquerade.

LOVE INTERESTS

Maximilian Windrake (The Crimson Reaper)

Territory after territory fell beneath the shadow of this black-haired prince with eyes like bleeding rubies, expanding Ravensburg into the sprawling empire it is today. The war may be over, but he cannot lay down his armor. He’s curt. He’s rough. And he’s a terrible conversationalist. Will you uncover the hidden depths of this fearsome prince, who seemingly only has duty on his mind?

Lucian Windrake (The Enigmatic Enchanter)

Free from the weight of the crown, the second prince knows how to have more fun. Beloved by all, he’s a ray of sunshine wherever he goes. Yet something about him feels… off. He seems to know everything, appears everywhere, and asks the most damning questions. Will you match his game or let yourself be played?

SIDE CHARACTERS

Victoria Rosemoore

If perfection exists, then she is it. The only daughter of Grand Duke Rosemoore, she is beautiful, rich, and betrothed to the crown prince. Most importantly, she's got the brains to make sure that no one gets in the way of getting what she wants.

Nerissa Valeine

This mysterious companion of the mighty Emperor is ignored and isolated by the Imperial Court. Her eyes hold a sadness and strength born from surviving the impossible, tempered by the courage to carve her own path.

Amelia Windrake

This adorable little princess of the Empire is sweet, curious, and full of wonder. Without a mother figure, it falls to you to guide her and show her the way.

♡ Customizable Heroine

Name your heroine and make the choices that shape your destiny.

♡ Two Unique Routes

Navigate two intertwined storylines, each with different challenges and dangers. Most importantly, lose yourself in two very different types of love. Only by journeying through both will you uncover the true mystery behind your own noble house.

♡ 8+ Endings

Many paths lead to heartbreak, betrayal, or even death. Hopefully, your wisdom and bravery will lead you to love and peace.

♡ Spicy Scenes

Your hard work will be rewarded with very steamy moments with the princes.

♡ Animated Spirits & CGs

Watch every scene come to life with moving characters with a wide range of expressions.

content_descriptors.notes: Fate's Masquerade contains mature themes, and player discretion is advised. These include but are not limited to violence, blood, murder, human death, animal death, strong language, alcohol references, and sexual references.

short_description: In this manhwa-inspired historical romance, uncover the mystery of your fallen noble lineage while navigating an imperial court brimming with secrets. Immerse yourself in beautifully animated scenes and make choices that shape your destiny. Will your story lead to love, power, freedom… or ruin?
